parsed.summary: Checkout-api error rate reached 18% with connection pool timeouts and max connections exhausted on orders-db after a deploy and scale-out.

likely_causes.description: Each checkout-api pod opens a pool of 15 connections, and autoscaling from 6 to 14 pods exceeded the max_connections limit of 200 on orders-db.

next_steps.action: Investigate connection exhaustion following the PostgreSQL connection exhaustion runbook.
